title: Smith Douglas Homes doubles down on pace despite margin pain

title: As America turns 250, let’s renew the promise of home
summary: As the US approaches its 250th anniversary, the column argues housing is central to economic opportunity, citing 12 million renters paying over 50% of income on rent and utilities. It highlights the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act and urges funding for home repair and starter home financing programs.

title: The pressure that reveals who you really are
summary: A leadership reflection on how pressure can flip internal dialogue without any external change. A quiet long run becomes a framework for noticing self-talk and resetting it by pausing and paying attention.

title: Mortgage spreads keeping housing demand intact for now
summary: Mortgage spreads at 2.01% are keeping 2026 mortgage rates near 6.74%, supporting pending sales and limiting year-over-year declines.
